exposure: number of risk-associated social determinants of health (SDOH)
cohort: Infants born at 22-26 weeks of gestation in National Institute of Child Health and Human Development Neonatal Research Network centers between 2006 and 2017 who survived to discharge.
finding: Children born to mothers with public/no insurance were older at discharge and more likely to be readmitted, while neurodevelopmental impairment and death postdischarge were more common among those exposed to multiple risk-associated social determinants of health.
